PJA 0.9.8 (tag v0.9.8, commit e89a500), https://github.com/YadeWira/PJA,
from the vendor tarball pja-0.9.8-zpaqstd.tar.gz of its release (sha256
f777a59f904be361e337b3fcdf285d9647b9a2d70659adf5c668d186d51c5cdc, as its
SHA256SUMS says; each of its 42 source and license files also compared
with the tag's: all the same), copied unmodified. Before it, PJA 0.6.3
(PMPA 0.3.x) and 0.6.2 (PMPA 0.2.0).

On the 55 real MP3 covers of PMPA's measurement set, 0.9.8 writes the very
same streams as 0.6.3: PMPA's stream version stays 8. What PMPA gains: the
fixes since 0.6.3, and pjamodel.GetSimd/SetSimd with pjav7.V7Retable, so
that pmpa --cpu reaches the covers' model (plain, sse41, avx2).

PMPA uses it for the JPEG pictures of ID3v2 tags (album covers): pjacodec.
Compress with version 7's model, pjacodec.Decompress. The JPEG 2000 units
come along (pjacodec uses them) and are never called. MIT (LICENSE);
NOTICE has PJA's third-party notes; VENDOR.md is PJA's note for zpaq-std.

Do not patch these files here: changes go to the PJA repository, and a new
release tag comes in whole, replacing this directory.
